> Blog · Pipeliners · 2026-06-23

# Summary
One of the 6 posts drafted and published in the June 22-23 session (per the handoff). Sources: `blog-drafts\whole-house-repipe.md`, the Gutenberg HTML in `blog-drafts\gutenberg\`, the FAQ schema HTML in `blog-drafts\faq-schema\`, and a featured image in `featured-img\`.

# Key facts
- **Focus keyword:** whole house repipe. URL /whole-house-repipe/ (post 15580, live in the July 21 blog inventory).
- Structure: quick answer, key takeaways, question H2s, FAQ with FAQPage schema.
- This page now runs Google Ads and is ad-protected. Scott confirmed Oct 1 that Pipeliners does not do full repipes; existing wording stays as is and no new repipe claims may be added. The content plan marks it as needing its own decision.
